SELECT decision_date, secid, date, settle, expected_change_bp, volume, openposition
FROM v_keyrate_expectations
WHERE decision_date IN (toDate('2026-10-23'), toDate('2026-12-18'))
  AND date >= toDate('2026-10-15') AND date <= toDate('2026-11-15')
ORDER BY decision_date, date DESC, secid LIMIT 40
SELECT * FROM v_point_in_time_version

SELECT decision_date, secid,
       argMax(settle, date) AS implied_rate,
       argMax(expected_change_bp, date) AS implied_change_bp,
       argMax(volume, date) AS volume, argMax(openposition, date) AS oi,
       max(date) AS as_of
FROM v_keyrate_expectations WHERE decision_date >= toDate('2026-11-15')
GROUP BY decision_date, secid ORDER BY decision_date

WITH d AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
           WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate' AND date >= toStartOfYear(toDate('2026-11-15')) - 15
           ORDER BY date WITH FILL FROM toStartOfYear(toDate('2026-11-15')) - 15 TO toDate('2026-11-16')
           INTERPOLATE (value AS value))
SELECT max(date) AS through, count() AS days, round(avg(value), 4) AS ytd_avg,
       argMax(value, date) AS rate_now
FROM d WHERE date >= toStartOfYear(toDate('2026-11-15'))

WITH m AS (SELECT event_date AS meeting, max(emergency) AS emergency
           FROM v_events_calendar
           WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%'
             AND event_date < toDate('2026-11-15') GROUP BY event_date),
     r AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate'),
     x AS (SELECT meeting, emergency,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <  meeting)     AS rate_before,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <= meeting + 4) AS rate_after
           FROM m CROSS JOIN r GROUP BY meeting, emergency)
SELECT meeting, emergency, rate_before, rate_after,
       round((rate_after - rate_before) * 100) AS step_bp,
       lagInFrame(step_bp) OVER (ORDER BY meeting) AS prev_step_bp
FROM x WHERE meeting >= toDate('2024-01-01') ORDER BY meeting

WITH m AS (SELECT event_date AS meeting, max(emergency) AS emergency
           FROM v_events_calendar
           WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%'
             AND event_date < toDate('2026-11-15') GROUP BY event_date),
     r AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate'),
     x AS (SELECT meeting, emergency,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <  meeting)     AS rate_before,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <= meeting + 4) AS rate_after
           FROM m CROSS JOIN r GROUP BY meeting, emergency),
     s AS (SELECT meeting, emergency, round((rate_after - rate_before) * 100) AS step_bp FROM x WHERE emergency = 0),
     t AS (SELECT meeting, step_bp,
                  lagInFrame(step_bp, 1) OVER (ORDER BY meeting) AS prev1,
                  lagInFrame(step_bp, 2) OVER (ORDER BY meeting) AS prev2
           FROM s)
SELECT 'after_prev' AS kind, toString(prev1) AS prev, toString(step_bp) AS step, count() AS n
FROM t WHERE prev1 IS NOT NULL AND NOT (prev1 = 0 AND prev2 = 0) GROUP BY prev1, step_bp
UNION ALL
SELECT 'after_two_holds', concat(toString(prev2), ',', toString(prev1)), toString(step_bp), count()
FROM t WHERE prev1 = 0 AND prev2 = 0 GROUP BY prev2, prev1, step_bp
ORDER BY kind, prev, step

SELECT meeting_date, block, subsection, count() AS paragraphs, sum(lengthUTF8(text)) AS chars,
       max(published) AS published
FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23')
GROUP BY meeting_date, block, subsection ORDER BY block, subsection

WITH m AS (SELECT event_date AS meeting, max(emergency) AS emergency
           FROM v_events_calendar
           WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%'
             AND event_date < toDate('2026-11-15') GROUP BY event_date),
     r AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate'),
     x AS (SELECT meeting, emergency,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <  meeting)     AS rate_before,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <= meeting + 4) AS rate_after
           FROM m CROSS JOIN r GROUP BY meeting, emergency),
     s AS (SELECT meeting, round((rate_after - rate_before) * 100) AS step_bp FROM x WHERE emergency = 0),
     t AS (SELECT meeting, step_bp,
                  lagInFrame(step_bp, 1) OVER (ORDER BY meeting) AS prev1,
                  lagInFrame(step_bp, 2) OVER (ORDER BY meeting) AS prev2
           FROM s)
SELECT toString(prev1) AS prev_step, toString(step_bp) AS step, count() AS n
FROM t WHERE prev1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY prev1, step_bp ORDER BY prev1, step_bp

SELECT meeting_date, block, subsection, count() AS paragraphs, sum(lengthUTF8(text)) AS chars
FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23')
GROUP BY meeting_date, block, subsection ORDER BY block, subsection

WITH m AS (SELECT event_date AS meeting, max(emergency) AS emergency
           FROM v_events_calendar
           WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%'
             AND event_date < toDate('2026-11-15') GROUP BY event_date),

SELECT toString(step_bp) AS step_after_two_holds, count() AS n

SELECT source, series, title, unit, frequency FROM v_series_catalog
WHERE (source = 'rosstat' AND (series ILIKE '%потребительских цен%' OR series ILIKE '%базов%' OR series ILIKE '%безработ%' OR series ILIKE '%заработная плата%'))

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series IN ('Базовый ИПЦ', 'Базовый ИПЦ:SAAR_q')

WITH c AS (
  SELECT date, value FROM v_rosstat_macro
  WHERE series = 'Индексы потребительских цен на товары и услуги по Российской Федерации'
    AND date >= toDate('2025-01-01')

  WHERE series IN ('Кредит экономике', 'М2 SA', 'Депозиты населения') AND date >= toDate('2025-01-01'))
SELECT series, date, round(value, 1) AS level,
       round((value / lagInFrame(value, 12) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY date) - 1) * 100, 2) AS yoy_pct

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_rosstat_macro
WHERE series IN ('Уровень безработицы', 'Среднемесячная номинальная начисленная заработная плата работников по полному кругу организаций')

SELECT source, series, round(sum(value), 2) AS ytd_sum_bn_rub, count() AS months, min(date) AS from_d, max(date) AS to_d

  AND series IN ('Доходы, всего', 'Расходы, всего', 'Дефицит (-)/Профицит (+)', 'Нефтегазовые доходы, всего')

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_moex_market WHERE date >= toDate('2026-10-01') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT source, date, round(value, 1) AS v FROM v_minfin_budget
WHERE date >= toDate('2026-01-01') AND series = 'Дефицит (-)/Профицит (+)'
ORDER BY source, date

SELECT source, series, title, unit, frequency FROM v_series_catalog
WHERE series ILIKE '%currency%' OR series ILIKE '%валют%' OR title ILIKE '%курс%' LIMIT 20

SELECT max(date) AS last_date, argMax(value, date) AS last_value, count() AS n
FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_currency_usd'

SELECT series, date, value, unit FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series IN ('Всего: свыше 1 года', 'от 1 года до 3 лет', 'Всего (кредиты физлицам): по всем срокам', 'Средневзвешенная ставка по жилищным кредитам, РФ')

SELECT kind, name, tenor, date, value FROM v_cbr_mirac
WHERE date >= toDate('2026-10-01') ORDER BY date DESC, kind, name LIMIT 24

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series IN ('Всего: свыше 1 года', 'от 1 года до 3 лет', 'Всего (кредиты физлицам): по всем срокам', 'Средневзвешенная ставка по жилищным кредитам, РФ')

SELECT block, count() AS n, sum(lengthUTF8(text)) AS chars FROM v_cbr_key_rate_press_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23') GROUP BY block ORDER BY block

SELECT seq, text FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks

WHERE publication_date >= toDate('2026-11-15') AND publication_date <= toDate('2026-12-18')
